_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: YES BANK Uni Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Rewards are issued as Uni coins. The listing calls the reward "1% cashback in uni coins" and the product page "1% Reward points (issued as Uni coins)"; no YES BANK page or document states what one Uni coin is worth in rupees.

eligibility_engine.notes: Apply on the partner (Uni) website or app; the partner may charge a platform fee. Page: age 21 to 60, salaried or self-employed, minimum net salary ₹25,000 a month or ITR of ₹7.5 lakh; existing YES BANK credit cardholders are not eligible.

action.reason: No Uni coins on fuel (Uni page T&C 1).
No Uni coins on wallet loads (T&C 1).
No Uni coins on government payments (T&C 1).
No Uni coins on utility payments (T&C 1).
No Uni coins on EMI transactions or cash advance / withdrawals (T&C 1).
No Uni coins on marketing and advertising services (T&C 1).
No Uni coins on international transactions (T&C 1).
Page: unlimited 1% reward points (rewards issued as Uni coins); listing: 1% cashback in uni coins on all transactions. The rupee value of a Uni coin is not stated, so 1% is the advertised figure.

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: MITC/KFS: foreign currency conversion and DCC charges are not applicable to this card

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% + GST when one fuel transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month fuel spend exceeds ₹50,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(i))
1% + GST on utility and service transactions when the previous calendar month's utility spend exceeded ₹50,000; fee capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(h))
1% of the transaction (minimum ₹1 up to ₹1,000; minimum ₹199 above ₹1,000) + GST; at most 5 rental transactions in 30 days (MITC 3(e))
No fee on third-party wallet loads up to ₹2,000; 1% + GST above ₹2,000, at most ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(f))

1% + GST on education paid through third-party sites and apps (CRED, PhonePe, Housing.com, NoBroker, CheQ etc.), capped at ₹5,000 per calendar month; direct school/college site, POS and international education payments are not charged (MITC 3(g))
1% + GST when one toll/transport transaction exceeds ₹10,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹75,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(j))
1% + GST when one transaction exceeds ₹30,000 or the calendar-month spend exceeds ₹80,000; capped at ₹5,000 per transaction (MITC 3(k))

reward_redemption_fee.notes: MITC 3(l): ₹100 + GST per redemption request regardless of points; ₹99 + GST convenience fee on flight bookings through points. Not applicable on cards without reward points.

components: 100% of GST + EMI amount + membership/rental/wallet fees + any amount over the credit limit
plus the higher of (finance charges + other fees + 2% of retail/cash outstanding) or ₹200 (MITC 6, KFS)

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Renewal fee ₹499 + taxes waived on retail spends of ₹50,000 or more within the 12 months before the renewal date; not applicable to lifetime-free cards (Uni page; MITC; KFS). Zero joining fee.

open_questions: Value of one Uni coin in rupees is not stated by YES BANK (re-checked in wave 3: product page, the page's Top Benefits and More-from items, its FAQs, the listing, MITC V18, the Cardmember Agreement and the Redemption Rules say nothing), so point_value_inr_baseline and effective_base_return_percent are null. The 1% is the advertised rate; the listing calls it "1% cashback in uni coins", the product page "Unlimited 1% Reward points (rewards issued as Uni coins)". Whether a partner-side coin conversion differs from the 1% is not stated by YES.

Network (settled 2026-11-07, W11): Mastercard, from card art on the YES BANK listing tile for "UNI Credit Card" (Mastercard logo). The product page, MITC and KFS do not name it; the MITC lists a separate "Uni RuPay Virtual" and the listing a separate "UNI Rupay Credit Card" page (lifetime free), which is a different product and not covered by this record.

Physical or virtual, and UPI linking, are not stated. The cash-advance fee (2.5% or ₹650) is written for a physical card. The listing compare-record for this card carries "unlimited international lounge access, 6 domestic" text that the product page and MITC do not state and that also appears on the virtual-only Klick record; it looks like template filler and is not stored.

The page "Top Benefits" slider and "More from this card" items were read in wave 3 from the page's content API: shop and earn Uni coins, zero forex mark-up, 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹500, annual fee waiver on ₹50,000 spend within 12 months of the card anniversary, contactless, MasterCard Secure Code. They add no rate, cap or coin value.
The page footnote says no coins on "international transactions"; the MITC does not repeat this. Reward expiry for Uni coins is not stated (MITC refers co-brand currencies to the product page).
The MITC fee table shows ₹5,000 in the joining-fee-waiver column for Uni although the joining fee is NIL; ignored as a table artefact.
notes: Forex mark-up and DCC are not applicable to this card (MITC 3(q), KFS), so both are stored as 0.
Fuel surcharge waiver: transactions up to ₹7,500, maximum ₹500 per statement cycle (page T&C 2, MITC 4); no waiver on UPI fuel transactions.
Fuel and utility fee thresholds for Uni are ₹50,000 (the higher tier in the MITC); toll threshold ₹75,000.

value.rule: 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement; nothing if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is ₹500 or less
value.note: A percentage fee cannot be written as fixed slabs, so late_payment_slabs is empty.

rules: Late payment charge: no charge if the current outstanding (statement balance + unbilled) is up to ₹500; above ₹500, 10% of the statement balance or ₹1,350, whichever is lower, per statement (MITC 3(b), KFS).

Auto-debit / payment return failure: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹500 whichever is higher on the net payable amount, capped at ₹5,000 per customer per statement (before that 2% or ₹450, cap ₹1,500); cheque return ₹450 (MITC 3(d)).
Overlimit: ₹550 + GST per transaction that exceeds the limit (facility reintroduced 1 Jun 2026) (MITC 3(c)).

Cash advance: from 15 Jun 2026, 2.5% or ₹650 whichever is higher; before that 2.5% or ₹500; not applicable to virtual cards; cash withdrawal suspended for the first 6 months after onboarding; limit up to 30% of the credit limit (MITC 3(a), 5).
